messages.subject: motionlogger actigraph and GGIR
parts:
Hello 
I'm new to GGIR, sorry if this is obvious.

I am analyzing the levels of physical activity in older people and, for this, we have used the motionlogger actigraph (AMI). I would like to know if I can analyze the raw data that this actigraph exports with GGIR or if, on the contrary, this format is not supported by GGIR.

If there is someone who can answer this question for me, I would be very grateful. 

Thank you very much!

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] motionlogger actigraph and GGIR
parts:
Hello Raquel,

As far as I know the Motionlogger AMI does not generate raw acceleration data with multiple values per second in units of gravitational acceleration that GGIR is designed for.

I suspect you will only have one value per 10 seconds or even less frequent, correct?

With kind regards,

Vincent


Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
